properties.name: app.base-url
properties.description: Base URL for the application (used in magic link emails). Example: http://localhost:8080 or https://app.budgeteer.dev

properties.name: app.login-success-url
properties.description: URL to redirect to after successful login.

properties.name: app.email-enabled
properties.description: Whether email sending is enabled. When false, magic links are logged to console (for development).

properties.name: app.cookies.secure
properties.description: Whether cookies should have the Secure flag (HTTPS only). Should be true in production.

properties.name: app.database.clean-on-startup
properties.description: Whether to clean the database on startup (dev only). Useful for testing registration flows with the same email.

properties.name: app.jwe.secret-key
properties.description: Secret key for JWE token encryption (Base64 encoded, 32 bytes). Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32

properties.name: app.jwe.access-token-expiry
properties.description: Access token expiry duration.

properties.name: app.jwe.refresh-token-expiry
properties.description: Refresh token expiry duration.

properties.name: app.jwe.magic-link-expiry
properties.description: Magic link token expiry duration.

properties.name: monzo.client-id
properties.description: Monzo OAuth client ID from developer portal.

properties.name: monzo.client-secret
properties.description: Monzo OAuth client secret from developer portal.

properties.name: monzo.redirect-uri
properties.description: Monzo OAuth redirect URI (must match developer portal configuration).

properties.name: monzo.auth-url
properties.description: Monzo OAuth authorization URL.

properties.name: monzo.token-url
properties.description: Monzo OAuth token exchange URL.

properties.name: monzo.api-base-url
properties.description: Monzo API base URL.

properties.name: encryption.secret-key
properties.description: Base64-encoded 256-bit secret key for AES-256-GCM encryption (Monzo tokens at rest). Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32

properties.name: info.app.name
properties.description: Application name for actuator info endpoint.

properties.name: info.app.description
properties.description: Application description for actuator info endpoint.

properties.name: info.app.version
properties.description: Application version for actuator info endpoint.

properties.name: info.app.profiles
properties.description: Active Spring profiles for actuator info endpoint.
